content.text:
The migration is complete and the build passes. Here's a summary of every change made:

## Migration Summary

### Removed
- **`pages/` directory** — deleted entirely (all 8 files)
- **`components/AppProvider.js`** — replaced by TypeScript version

### New App Router Structure

```
app/
├── layout.tsx          ← replaces _app.js + _document.js
├── page.tsx            ← replaces pages/index.js
├── not-found.tsx       ← replaces pages/404.js
├── error.tsx           ← replaces pages/_error.js
├── blog/
│   ├── page.tsx        ← replaces pages/blog/index.js
│   └── [id]/
│       └── page.tsx    ← replaces pages/blog/[id].js
└── api/
    └── posts/
        ├── route.ts    ← replaces pages/api/posts/index.js
        └── [id]/
            └── route.ts ← replaces pages/api/posts/[id].js

components/
├── AppProvider.tsx     ← converted from .js, added types + "use client"
├── NavigateButton.tsx  ← new client component for router.push
├── BackButton.tsx      ← new client component for router.back
└── GoHomeButton.tsx    ← new client component for 404 page
```

### Key API Replacements

| Pages Router API | App Router Replacement |
|---|---|
| `getServerSideProps` | Async Server Component + `cache: "no-store"` on fetch |
| `getStaticProps` + `revalidate` | Async Server Component + `next: { revalidate: N }` on fetch |
| `getStaticPaths` | `generateStaticParams()` |
| `next/head` `<Head>` | `export const metadata` / `generateMetadata()` |
| `_app.js` + `_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` (root layout) |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` |
| `pages/_error.js` + `getInitialProps` | `app/error.tsx` (`"use client"` with `error`/`reset` props) |
| `useRouter()` from `next/router` | `useRouter()` from `next/navigation` (in `"use client"` components) |
| `router.isFallback` | Removed (not needed with `generateStaticParams`) |
| API route `handler(req, res)` | Named `GET`/`POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE` exports using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` |
| `req.query` for params | `params: Promise<{ id: string }>` from route context |
| `res.status().json()` | `NextResponse.json(data, { status })` |

### Types Added
- All components and pages use TypeScript with proper interfaces (`Post`, `Comment`, `BlogPostProps`, `RouteContext`, `ErrorProps`, `AppContextValue`, etc.)
- All files converted from `.js` to `.tsx`/`.ts`
